name: design-baseline
description: Design-baseline donor. Typecheck-only as a library (npx tsc --noEmit), with donor-owned component tests (npm test); ships an optional donor-dev gallery (npm run gallery) that renders the archetype demos. Neither the test harness nor the gallery is part of the baseline broadcast — see STYLE.md.

scripts.gallery:view: vite build --configLoader runner && vite preview --configLoader runner --port 5173

notes: react / react-dom are in devDependencies for donor typechecking only (npx tsc --noEmit) — target projects pin their own; do not copy the devDependencies block into a target.
@types/node is donor-dev-only — its `process` types typecheck the icon-button NODE_ENV dev warning in button.tsx (promoted from controlling-app); never copy into a target.
Charts (recharts, nivo), auth (next-auth, @supabase/supabase-js), data fetching (@tanstack/react-query) are NOT in the baseline. Add per project.

vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, @tailwindcss/vite, react-router-dom are donor-dev-only — they power the gallery harness (gallery/, vite.config.ts) and are NOT part of the baseline. Never copy them or the gallery into a target.

vitest, @testing-library/react, jsdom are donor-dev-only — they run the donor's own component tests (vitest.config.ts, src/**/*.test.tsx) verifying primitives against each other. Not part of the baseline broadcast; never copy them into a target.
